title: Book 2 — Euterpe, Chapter 274
paragraphs: The Egyptians hold their solemn assemblies not once in the year but often, especially and with the greatest zeal and devotion at the city of Bubastis for Artemis, and next at Busiris for Isis; for in this city is a very great temple of Isis, and this city stands in the middle of the Delta of Egypt (now Isis is, in the tongue of the Hellenes, Demeter). Thirdly, they hold a solemn assembly at the city of Saïs for Athene; fourthly, at Heliopolis for the Sun (Helios); fifthly, at the city of Buto in honour of Leto; and sixthly, at the city of Papremis for Ares.
